newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault warns of worse 96 in comm vehicles.
newsitem.headline: Renault warns of worse 96 in comm vehicles.

text.p: Renault said on Thursday that it had already forecast a 1996 negative operating profit from its commercial vehicles division but was now expecting this result to be worse than initially feared.

The group said in a nine-month sales statement earlier: "The negative contribution from the commercial vehicles division will be considerably more pronounced than anticipated". But it had not said explicitly that it was talking about the full-year.

Asked by Reuters to elaborate, a Renault spokeswoman said: "We already said the operating result (for commercial vehicles) would be negative for the year. We're now saying it will be more than anticipated".
She said the first-half operating result for the division had been positive to the tune of 26 million francs ($5.1 million).
